title: Automatic Configuration of LLM Post-Training Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2603.18773v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM post-training pipelines that combine supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning are difficult to configure under realistic compute budgets: the configuration space is high-dimensional and heterogeneous, stages are strongly coupled, and each end-to-end evaluation is expensive. We propose AutoPipe, a budget-aware two-phase framework for configuration selection in LLM post-training. Offline, AutoPipe learns a dataset-conditioned learning-to-rank surrogate from historical runs, capturing within-dataset preferences and providing transferable guidance toward promising regions of the configuration space. Online, for a new dataset, AutoPipe uses the offline guidance to steer Bayesian optimization and models dataset-specific deviations with a Gaussian-process residual surrogate. translated_title: 大语言模型后训练流水线的自动配置
translated_abstract: 结合监督微调与强化学习的大语言模型后训练流水线在实际算力预算下难以配置：配置空间高维且异构，各阶段之间强耦合，且每次端到端评估成本高昂。我们提出了AutoPipe，一个面向大语言模型后训练配置选择的预算感知两阶段框架。在离线阶段，AutoPipe从历史运行记录中学习一个以数据集为条件的排序学习代理模型，捕捉数据集内部的偏好，并提供可迁移的引导，指向配置空间中有希望的区域。在在线阶段，针对新数据集，AutoPipe利用离线引导来引导贝叶斯优化，并通过高斯过程残差代理模型来建模数据集特有的偏差。为降低评估成本，每次试验都会被提前停止，并由一个学习得到的预测器进行评分，该预测器将早期训练信号映射为最终性能的低成本代理指标。
tldr: AutoPipe是一个预算感知的两阶段框架，通过离线学习排序代理模型与在线贝叶斯优化相结合，自动为大语言模型后训练流水线选择配置，大幅降低配置搜索的算力成本。
en_tdlr: AutoPipe is a budget-aware two-phase framework that automatically selects configurations for LLM post-training pipelines by combining offline learning-to-rank surrogates with online Bayesian optimization, substantially reducing the compute cost of configuration search.
